decisions.reason: The original refinement equality uses H_s from (t_k,t_{k+1}] at s=t_k, hence uses the previous coefficient instead of M_{t_k}. This is a false equality in the core L2 Cauchy argument. Repaired the coefficient bookkeeping to [t_k,t_{k+1}). Also repaired stopped-bracket compatibility, the raw-stopping representative caveat, and finite-variation summation by parts without assuming A,C adapted. The representative caveat is necessary: an a.s.-continuous adapted martingale on an incomplete filtration can have a nonmeasurable raw stopped value; the explicit counterexample is recorded in repair_notes.

The initial Tonelli application does not establish product measurability of f(b-c) for a merely Lebesgue measurable f. Apply the proved Lebesgue change-of-variables theorem to the given joint density under the determinant-one shear, including its exceptional null set, then use completed-product agreement and Tonelli only on the separated factors. The Countable Choice hypothesis actually required by these local measure suppliers is now explicit. The distributional hypotheses and independence/density conclusions are retained.

The actual cited supplier contains the construction: lem-test-function-cutoffs-and-euclidean-localization proof 1.1 fixes a single smooth bump b, forms translated dilates b_j, and gives chi=1-product(1-b_j) for a finite rational-ball cover. Its step 3.1 explicitly fixes a coding of finite rational lists and takes the least covering code. For each prescribed K_n and O, the consumer uses precisely that least-code rule and the same fixed bump. It defines a function of n by a unique natural-number minimum; no countable choice of arbitrary cutoff witnesses occurs. The full supplier even asserts a choice-free countable locally finite partition of unity. The objection overlooks its complete argument.

The last sentence of step 3.1 explicitly invokes the Levy supplier proof on the finite horizon, rather than assuming a whole-line extension. Inspected both the full vector proof and its scalar characteristic-exponential supplier. In scalar steps 2.1–8.1 use the bounded-horizon hit stop inf{u<=T:|N_u|>=m} capped at T: stopped clocks are t wedge stop, terminal square sums have uniform L2 bounds, Taylor remainders vanish, and dominated convergence is bounded by exp(theta^2 T/2), including t=T. The vector proof then applies scalar identities to linear functionals and uses Fourier event tests to identify Gaussian increments independent of F_s. All these arguments concern 0<=s<t<=T; no hypothesis about a process beyond T enters. The existing proof-adaptation sentence is mathematically justified.

reviews.reason: Reviewed all eight steps after repair. Everywhere-continuous adapted input representatives justify raw bounded stopping. Corrected common-refinement coefficients give the L2 Cauchy/Doob estimate; pointwise limits preserve adaptation and stopped measurability. Partial-sum identities give compatible stopped brackets and true stopped compensators. Polarization and summation by parts prove the product formula even for nonadapted finite-variation parts. A zero bracket makes the finite-variation martingale square a nonnegative local martingale started at zero, hence zero. The necessary representative caveat changes the Statement; every direct consumer was examined. This is repair-author review, not independent acceptance.

The determinant-one shear transports the null exceptional set by change of variables applied to its indicator. The transformed density factors depend on separate coordinates, so completed-product agreement licenses Tonelli; integration of p_C gives p_A f and independence. Countable Choice is explicitly inherited from the proved measure suppliers. The only direct consumer already assumes full AC and remains sound. No density regularity or distributional conclusion is weakened.

Checked all four steps and the full cutoff supplier. Compact support and classical p,g justify interior differentiation; the adjoint identity has the correct negative sign; the explicit weighted-flux integrability dominates the time integral and permits both endpoints. The least-coded rational finite covers give the required cutoff sequence without Countable Choice. Dominated convergence with |Z| and pi-lambda give all Borel terminal-state event tests, and reverse Markov factorization extends them to the full reversed natural filtration. No item, contract or page edit is needed.

Reviewed augmentation, stopped trace-energy completion, elementary isometry, product-compensator passage, pasting, original-adapted Brownian descent and recovery. Re-examined the changed quadratic-variation Statement: proof 1.1 explicitly normalizes continuous processes in the usual augmentation before every F2 use, satisfying its representative convention. The full scalar/vector Levy proof works through T. Item guard is unchanged; current supplier quotation mirrors were repaired only in the contract. No independent acceptance of a repair is claimed.

interface_events.mathematical_evidence: Without this convention, take Omega=[0,1], F_t=Borel([0,1]) for all t, Borel Lebesgue probability, a Borel null Cantor set N and a non-Borel D subset N excluding 0. Put M_t(omega)=1 if omega=t and t belongs to D, and 0 otherwise. Each fixed-time value is Borel and zero a.s., so M is a true martingale, continuous on Omega minus N. The Borel stopping time tau(omega)=omega has M_tau=1_D, which is not measurable. Thus the original unconditional raw-stopping clause is false. The repaired convention excludes this raw representative and preserves the conclusion for normalized continuous versions.
